title: The Lantern Procession
text: A procession of floating lanterns drifts by in the dusk, hundreds of them, silent paper and candle. Each one carries the soul of someone recently dead, the old folk say, on their way to wherever souls go. One of them flickers and turns toward you.

options.label: The most troubled follows the lantern that turned to them, knowing who it must be.

outcomes.text: It is someone they knew, come to say goodbye. This time they are able to say it back.

options.label: Catch one in a jar; a soul's light is worth a great deal.

outcomes.text: It burns bright and sad in the jar, forever searching for the others. Something beyond the Gate notices the theft.

options.label: Bow until they pass, and let the dead go on their way.

outcomes.text: The night is darker once they have passed. Still, the lantern that turned toward you leaves a little warmth in every chest.

options.label: The devout one prays for the lantern that came close, to light its way.

outcomes.text: It brightens and drifts on lighter. Its thanks lingers in the devout one's hands as warmth.
